_comment: Checkov policy for Phase 4 infrastructure. The free checkov reports no severity, so failing on every finding blocked almost every run. This policy decides instead: only fail_on severities block; checks listed under severity get that score; any other unscored check is unreported_severity (a warning shown to the DevOps Lead at P4-G4); findings under third_party_paths (downloaded modules) are reported, never blocking, because they cannot be fixed here. INITIAL POLICY: the DevOps Lead must review and extend the severity list.
